gloss: to record; to document; to register

definitions.gloss: to record; to document; to write down
definitions.explanation: To preserve information by writing it down, filming it, or storing it in some form for future reference.

definitions.gloss: to set a record; to register a figure
definitions.explanation: To achieve or register a particular number, score, or measurement, especially a notable one.

examples.japanese: {会議|かいぎ}の{内容|ないよう}を{記録|きろく}した。
examples.english: I recorded the contents of the meeting.

examples.japanese: {毎日|まいにち}の{体重|たいじゅう}をノートに{記録|きろく}している。
examples.english: I'm recording my daily weight in a notebook.

examples.japanese: {戦争|せんそう}の{体験|たいけん}を{映像|えいぞう}で{記録|きろく}し、{後世|こうせい}に{伝|つた}えることが{大切|たいせつ}だ。
examples.english: It is important to record wartime experiences on film and pass them on to future generations.

examples.japanese: {最高|さいこう}{気温|きおん}を{記録|きろく}した。
examples.english: A record high temperature was registered.

examples.japanese: {売上|うりあげ}が{過去|かこ}{最高|さいこう}を{記録|きろく}した。
{今年|ことし}の{夏|なつ}は{観測|かんそく}{史上|しじょう}{最|もっと}も{暑|あつ}い{気温|きおん}を{記録|きろく}し、{各地|かくち}で{熱中症|ねっちゅうしょう}の{患者|かんじゃ}が{増|ふ}えた。
examples.english: This summer registered the hottest temperatures on record, and heatstroke patients increased across the country.

notes:
A versatile suru-verb with two distinct uses. Sense 1 (to document) covers any act of preserving information — writing notes, filming, logging data, etc. Sense 2 (to register a figure) is commonly seen in news about weather records, economic figures, and sports achievements.

The noun form {記録|きろく} means "record" or "documentation" and appears in many compounds.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {記録|きろく}に{残|のこ}す: to leave on record
- {記録|きろく}を{更新|こうしん}する: to break/update a record
- {記録|きろく}を{保持|ほじ}する: to hold a record
- {映像|えいぞう}に{記録|きろく}する: to record on video
- {世界|せかい}{記録|きろく}: world record
- {記録|きろく}{的|てき}な: record-breaking

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {録音|ろくおん}する: to record (audio) — specifically for sound recording
- {録画|ろくが}する: to record (video) — specifically for video recording
- {記載|きさい}する: to describe; to state in writing — formal, used for official documents
